description: This file defines the BlockPluginInterface, an interface for Drupal block plugins, specifying methods for access control, rendering, configuration, and other plugin behaviors.

classes.name: BlockPluginInterface
classes.description: Interface for Drupal block plugins, defining methods for label, access, build, placeholder creation, configuration, validation, submission, and machine name suggestion.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns the user-facing label of the block.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks if a user session has access to the block, returning a boolean or an AccessResultInterface object.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the renderable array for the block.

methods.name: createPlaceholder
methods.description: Indicates whether the block should be rendered in a placeholder.

methods.name: setConfigurationValue
methods.description: Sets a specific configuration value for the block.

methods.name: blockForm
methods.description: Provides configuration form elements for the block.

methods.name: blockValidate
methods.description: Performs validation on the block configuration form.

methods.name: blockSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the block configuration form.

methods.name: getMachineNameSuggestion
methods.description: Suggests a machine name for the block instance.
